collection.description: Two fathers disagree about a young child's bedtime while a neighbor keeps assuming roles.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: Two men caring for a young child disagree about bedtime. A neighbor keeps assuming one must be 'the mother.'

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The neighbor adjusts their language; the child falls asleep halfway through the discussion.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: A familiar song and routine work better than either father's elaborate plan.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A trusted relative babysits so the tired fathers can rest; the neighbor learns not to assume roles.
